purpose: Cross-language parity fixtures. The Kotlin :core module must reproduce every number in these files. Regenerate with `npm run vectors` after any change to core physics, math or locomotion.
notes: All values are produced by the deterministic core, which avoids libm entirely.
Tolerance 1e-9 absorbs JSON decimal rounding, not platform drift: a correct port matches to ~1e-15.
If the Kotlin side fails here, the port is wrong. Do not loosen the tolerance.
